honest_note: Calibration metrics only -- no $ / edge / profit claim.  REPLICATION_PENDING means n_rep==1: the candidate passed the 5-gate ratchet on one corpus but requires a second independent corpus before it can SHIP.  vs_close stays UNPROVEN: the model has not yet beaten the true close on held-out outcome Brier across >=2 independent corpora with clustered DM p<0.05.  INSUFFICIENT_DATA is honest when the proposals file is absent or empty.  All values are probabilities, never dollar amounts.
